main_body: Tall wooden bookshelf with a dark brown frame and three shelf compartments holding books, a plant and red items, drawn straight from the front
top_band: none. The column starts with a dark brown frame at row 10, then the tan back panel (rows 11-13) and a light tan shelf edge (rows 14-15). There is no lighter horizontal top surface above the frame.
evidence: The bookshelf is a flat front elevation. The top of the carcass at rows 10-11 is only a dark 1-2px frame line, with no visible cap or top surface. Each shelf board shows only a 2-3 row light tan front edge (rows 14-15, 22-23, 32-33, 41-43). These read as vertical shelf fronts, not horizontal surfaces seen from above. The compartments are inset with dark inner edges, but that does not make a top. This matches the guide's red 'front elevation' and 'rim only' cases.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown tinted to the wood, which is right. The wood has about 4 steps: dark frame, mid brown, tan, and light tan shelf edges. The books are small flat blocks with few highlights. The back panels (rows 11-13, 25-31) are mostly flat fills, and the frame has no grain or speckle. Next to the stall and well references, which have scalloped roof tiles, stone shading and more tones per tile, it is thinner and flatter, with lower tile density.
